messages:
ashok: :rotating_light: paging oncall — automated SLO alert: streaming p99 latency spike in us-west-2 (svc/inference-stream). p95 ~220ms -> 480ms, p99 ~1.9s -> 6.3s. impact: client retries reported. first seen 10:12 UTC
incident-bot: Alert 2649998888 created (severity: P1). Pager routed to @ashok and @sam. Related metrics links: https://metrics.redwood/internal/dashes/streaming-p99?s=2649998000&t=2649999000
maria: I’m on it — looking at node-level telemetry now. Can you lane traffic to smaller model variants if needed?
ashok: yes please, try graceful fallback; owners: runtime (maria) + oncall (ashok). @lee FYI for infra-level escalation.
sam: I see a tail of stalled responses in the streaming traces — most affected requests show a long GPU stall before any tokens. KV cache hit rates normal.
maria: checking GPU telemetry: one rack in us-west-2 shows rising ECC correctable errors on node gpu-uw2-17; error count increased at 10:09 UTC. Also device power limit events and TCC throttling flags.
lee: nvlink CRC errors also spiking from same rack, looks like flaky interconnect on that hostgroup. Good candidate for draining.
ashok: customer impact? any premium customers degraded?
sam: two customers on dedicated pools saw p99 breaches and an increase in streaming retries. No complete failures, but elevated error rates for websocket keepalive timeouts. Logged in CS portal.
maria: mitigation plan: 1) immediate isolate/mark node gpu-uw2-17 degraded in scheduler 2) trigger fallback routing for in-flight streams to compatible lower-latency variants 3) enable forced CPU fallback for long-running streams over 10s 4) notify customers via status page if we expect >10m impact
ashok: do step 1+2 now. sam, help with in-flight tracing to identify sessions to migrate.
sam: running migration script:```
# migrate all active streams off hostgroup uw2-rack-5
curl -XPOST https://api.redwood/ops/migrate -d '{"selector":"uw2-rack-5","drain":true}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPS'
```
maria: scheduler reports drain ack; starting proxy-level fallback. Routing rules applied: route streaming -> fallback-small-quant if target hostgroup flagged.
ops-bot: Node gpu-uw2-17 flagged DEGRADED by ops at 10:20 UTC. Autoscaler will not place new workloads.
lee: ops team doing remote power-cycle and ECC farm test; if NVLink flakiness persists we'll hot-swap to nodes in rack-3.
ashok: hooking in CS for customers impacted. Maria, estimate mitigation latency improvement?
maria: initial effect: p95 back to ~250ms within 45s of switching; p99 still 1.2s due to stream reconnects and backlog. ongoing drains will reduce further.
sam: tracing shows streaming stage stalls correspond to long GPU kernel wait times, scheduler queue backlog. Likely kernel preemption delays under thermal/power cap.
lee: rack-level telemetry shows ambient temp jump + 5C around 10:08 UTC and PSU current spikes — hardware might have triggered sustained power-capping. That causes slow clocks and longer kernels.
ashok: good find. Action: keep rack drained, escalate RMA for affected nodes, and create temporary routing policy to prefer low-latency nodes in other AZs.
maria: rolling policy now: cross-region spill to us-west-1 for non-dedicated traffic and to dedicated spare-pool for reserved capacity customers.
sam: adding regression alert for streaming p99 to detect reoccurrence. Also saving traces for postmortem.
ashok: handoff — @sam you stay until stable, @maria coordinate with infra for RMA, @lee follow hardware diagnostics. I’ll update leadership and oncall rotation.
incident-bot: Incident 2649998888 severity downgraded to P2 at 10:40 UTC — p99 reduced to 780ms and no new customer retries after migration.
maria: confirming no further ECC correction surge after power-cycle on node; however NVLink CRC still elevated on two peer nodes — keeping them isolated.
lee: ops scheduled hardware swap for nodes gpu-uw2-17, gpu-uw2-19 at 14:00 UTC.
sam: postmortem checklist created: include timeline, root cause hypothesis (thermal + power cap -> ECC+NVLink flake -> kernel stalls), mitigation steps, and quantify customer impact (#customers, avg added latency, retry counts).
ashok: thanks team. Quick notes to status page: brief outage language + current mitigation steps + expected next update in 1h. :thumbsup:
maria: leaving a marker to correlate this incident with recent cooling maintenance in us-west-2 — ops to include A/C logs.
lee: filing ticket with HW vendor for NVLink CRC anomaly.
sam: I’ll keep the thread open while we watch for recurrence. close when all nodes replaced and alerts quiet.
ashok: closing? wait for confirmation from ops and CS. otherwise keep oncall.
ops-bot: Customer-notify: status.redwoodinc.com updated at 10:32 UTC.
